Randomization detection test (A4 W10): runs 100 shuffles plus 50 GBM synthetic runs against shuffled bars. If a strategy still shows edge on shuffled/GBM data the backtester likely has a lookahead/future-data leak. Hard gate on TESTING->PAPER lifecycle promotion (fail-closed).

Hard gate on PAPER->DEPLOY_READY when SDR < 0.85 OR PSI > 0.05 OR RWS > 0.20 (QuantForgeAnalytics 2026-05-16 institutional spec). Advisory-only when B15_BATTERY_ENABLED=false (30-day grandfather period). Required because perturbation-fragility kills strategies that survive WF/CPCV/PBO/DSR.
